title: Lo utha mola askari ka janaza loogo
body:
Lo utha mola askari ka janaza loogo
Ye tha kanoone sitamgar ka irada loogo
Motammed billah laeen ne hai zaher sha ko diye
Dekho islam ka udaa hai libaada loogo
<<DIVIDER>>
Haay khanjar se koi teere sitam koi zaher
Yoo hai sadat ko ummat ne nawaza loogo.
Samera me hai koi koofa koi shaam me hai
Bikhra khatoone qayamat ka shiraaza loogo
<<DIVIDER>>
Laal zehra swt se woh jannat ki basharat lenga
Jo hai mazloom ke matam se amaada loogo
